text: ATARNEA, an ancient town of Myfn, flatuated between Akrimytition and Plans, remarkable for the marriage of Arribite with the filter or consecutive of the tyrant Hermias; also for the dotage of that phi-lolopier.

parsed.faithful: ATARNEIA, an ancient town of Myfia, fituated between Adramyttium and Pitane, remarkable for the marriage of Aristotle with the fister or concubine of the tyrant Hermias; alfo for the dotage of that philofopher.
parsed.modern: ATARNEIA, an ancient town of Myfia, situated between Adramyttium and Pitane, remarkable for the marriage of Aristotle with the sister or concubine of the tyrant Hermias; also for the dotage of that philosopher.
